exposure: Immediate postpartum long-acting reversible contraception (LARC) coverage
cohort: A theoretical cohort of 100,000 people with Medicaid insurance who were immediately postpartum and did not have permanent contraception.
finding: Coverage of immediate postpartum LARC at the time of index delivery is a cost-effective strategy that improves quality of life and reduces healthcare costs for Medicaid programs, leading to fewer repeat births, short interpregnancy intervals, severe maternal morbidity, and preterm births.
